title: Harden browser evaluator host semantics
objective: Make browser evaluator initialization cleanup, POSIX path normalization, environment validation, and output sinks fail-safe and regression tested

oracles: Node browser-host unit tests for failure cleanup and POSIX/environment semantics

handoff.summary: Transactional browser evaluator initialization now terminates its compiler worker and restores explicit and runtime-added globals on failure or termination. Browser host paths and environment state use tested POSIX/CPython-like validation, process.env is a coherent read-through proxy, and stdout/stderr have separate callbacks.
risks: The focused evaluator test imports generated dist modules, so it must run after the flint-wasm build in a clean checkout.
next_steps: Run the package's build-plus-test command once the pinned production artifact build completes in the integration lane.
